requirement.statement: The numerical result agrees with the analytical result under the declared tolerance.
preconditions: The input lies inside the represented finite domain.

setup: Construct the declared finite input using binary64 values.

oracle.independence_rationale: The expected value is derived analytically without invoking the implementation under test.

acceptance.zero_handling: Use the absolute criterion when the expected value is zero.
acceptance.nonfinite_behavior: Any nonfinite observed or expected value fails the test.

interpretation: Agreement establishes bounded numerical verification for the represented input and criterion only.

establishes: The implementation agrees with the independent analytical result for the represented input.
does_not_establish: Scientific-model adequacy, behavior outside the represented domain, or uncertainty quantification.

limitations.statement: Only one finite input is represented.
limitations.consequence: No claim is made for unrepresented inputs or nonfinite behavior beyond explicit rejection.
